name: Kiwi Kush Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Savor the fruity flavors of Kiwi Kush, a tropical indica strain. It offers a unique experience with an inhale of ripe kiwi and exhale of tangy berries and spicy earth accents. The taste is both sweet and invigorating, making it an ideal choice for an evening unwind or a gathering with loved ones. Kiwi Kush’s provides a tingling sensation, followed by a relaxing body buzz that doesn't overwhelm.
